uid.description: Lowercase canonical RFC 4122/9562 UUID using version 1 through 8 and the RFC variant.

designation.description: Opaque non-empty identifier with no control characters or surrounding whitespace.

endpointPair.description: Exactly two terminal references. Endpoint order has no electrical meaning.

typeId.description: A library-qualified type identifier in <library-name>:<type-name> form.

electricalIntent.description: Declared electrical intent. This is distinct from equipment capability or rating.

nominal_voltage.description: Nominal voltage in volts (V), the canonical source unit.

polarity.description: Opaque polarity classification, such as positive, negative, or neutral.

current.description: Current in amperes (A), the canonical source unit.

power.description: Power in watts (W), the canonical source unit.

frequency.description: Frequency in hertz (Hz), the canonical source unit.

electricalRating.description: Equipment electrical capability or rating. This is distinct from declared electrical intent.

nominal_voltage.description: Nominal voltage in volts (V), the canonical source unit.

current.description: Current in amperes (A), the canonical source unit.

power.description: Power in watts (W), the canonical source unit.

frequency.description: Frequency in hertz (Hz), the canonical source unit.
